fanTake: Well, that was the kind of dominant defensive performance that reminds you why you fall in love with Patriots football in the first place. We absolutely smothered Pittsburgh's offense—the kind of suffocating game where the Steelers managed just three points and looked thoroughly confused all afternoon. TreVeyon Henderson picked the perfect time to make his season debut with a 39-yard touchdown run, Eli Ponder added a fumble recovery score, and our defense turned the whole thing into a masterclass in clock management and field position. The only blemish on an otherwise beautiful afternoon was watching Mike Onwenu get carted off with an ankle injury late in the first quarter, but on a day when we were this good on defense, it's hard to complain too much about a 20-3 win.
